title_original: Steven Spielberg to direct Jessie Buckley, Cillian Murphy in Focus western scripted by Paul Thomas Anderson
excerpt_original: Mark Rylance will also star. Feature expected in 2028.

blocks.alt: Steven Spielberg / Jessie Buckley / Cillian Murphy / Paul Thomas Anderson

blocks.text: Source: Motion Picture Association, Universal / Trae Patton, The Academy / Getty Images for BAFTA, Richard Harbaugh / Trae Patton, The Academy
Steven Spielberg / Jessie Buckley / Cillian Murphy / Paul Thomas Anderson

Steven Spielberg will make one of his wishes come true and direct a western in a red-hot project for Focus Features based on a screenplay by Paul Thomas Anderson. Rounding out the lineup of Oscar winners is a cast of Jessie Buckley, Cillian Murphy, and Mark Rylance.

Anderson has adapted the screenplay from the 2024 novel The Heart In Winter by Irish author Kevin Barry. The story will centre on two lovers on the run from a posse of gunslingers as they head for San Francisco.

Unusually, Anderson has written a screenplay that he will not direct. Spielberg said on Monday that he had been waiting to collaborate with Anderson for some time, adding that the filmmakers wanted to tell a story set in the Old West in the late 1800s.

Spielberg won directing Oscars for Schindler’s List in 1994 and Saving Private Ryan in 1999. Anderson won his first directing Oscar last season for One Battle After Another , as well as for adapted screenplay.

Spielberg worked with Focus Features as a producer on last season’s awards heavyweight Hamnet , which garnered Buckley the lead actress Oscar. Murphy won the best lead actor Academy Award for Oppenheimer in 2024, and Rylance won supporting actor in 2016 for Spielberg’s Bridge Of Spies .
Producers are Kristie Macosko Krieger, Sara Murphy, Anderson, and Spielberg. Tim Headington, Neil Shah, Ryan Zacarias, and Ana Leocha serve as executive producers.
According to reports the feature is expected in 2028.
